# Translations for `tracy-business/j6` **1.1.0**

A byte-for-byte copy of [`../1.0.0/`](../1.0.0/README.md) — read there for the source, the checks
and the limits. It exists because **`--add-language` looks translations up by the contract id that
`multilingual.plan` returns**, and a site built from the 1.1.0 archive reports `tracy-business/j6/1.1.0`.
A folder missing here means the seeder calls the model for 778 strings the package already has
translated — not an error, just a cost.

The en-GB part of 1.1.0 is identical to 1.0.0 (the 1.1.0 contract reuses 1.0.0's `content-map.json`),
so slot keys and `sample` match and this copy is correct. A new version whose en-GB part changes must
be translated again, not copied.
